source_review.notes: Reviewed current C++ WG21 draft, Rust Reference, Java Language Specification, POSIX.1-2024, OpenMP 6.0, MPI 5.0, CUDA and SYCL specifications plus primary linearizability and multicore scaling work. Normative-version, semantic, portability and performance-scope limits are retained.

evidence: Candidate, claim, gate, evidence, support matrix, performance envelope, fault envelope, waivers, risks and decision are distinct.
Safety, progress, portability, performance, recovery and release terms are not conflated.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked gate-state vocabulary and claim quantification.

evidence: Recomputed executable matrix as 8 pass and 2 blocking gates.
Verified release_allowed is false because recovery is blocked and required device portability unavailable.
Snippet passed exact stdout and zero exit status.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Gate counts are metadata, not weighted confidence or approval percentage.

evidence: Verified release predicate requires every mandatory gate to pass under waiver/nonwaivable policy.
Checked evidence composition requires aligned candidate identity, assumptions and interfaces.
Checked claims are bounded by supported, performance and fault envelopes S, P and F.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No evidence type is represented as subsuming all others.

evidence: Reviewed empty/uneven/max/adversarial inputs, cancellation/shutdown, overload/resource exhaustion, ABA/reclamation and unsafe/FFI boundaries.
Reviewed compiler/runtime/architecture/device/MPI/storage cells, unsupported targets, numeric extremes, tracing loss and stale evidence.
Reviewed unavailable evidence, flaky recovery, expiring waivers, external-effect duplication, radiotherapy and autonomous-drone transfer.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Covers semantic, lifecycle, progress, numeric, portability, scaling, recovery, security and high-stakes boundaries.

evidence: Every release claim maps to a mandatory gate, candidate-bound evidence, assumptions, owner/reviewer and limitation.
Ownership, memory order, lifetime, progress, resources, outputs and side effects are reviewed across all transitions.
Required failed/blocked/unavailable gates cannot be averaged away; freshness and contradiction checks precede decision.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked the full contract-to-decision evidence chain.

evidence: Specification-to-implementation, evidence-validity, portability/scale, recovery/operation and decision obligations are separate.
Testing, sanitizers, systematic checking, static analysis, proof, benchmarks and fault injection have explicit scopes.
Triangulation requires independent methods and model/implementation mappings rather than evidence-count voting.
proof_review.notes: Approval remains candidate- and scope-specific, never universal correctness.

evidence: The executable gate model disclaims real-code review and equal gate risk.
Formal, dynamic, empirical, portability and worst-case claims remain distinguishable.
Radiotherapy and drone cases name required human reviewers and claim none.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Treatment/flight authorization, certification and domain validation remain external.

evidence: Python gate decision reproduced exact output.
Required evidence binds source/binary/configuration, commands/results, positive/negative probes, target cells, raw benchmark/fault artifacts and limitations.
Performance comparisons require equivalent correct work, repetitions/uncertainty and causal signals; recovery requires observed RPO/RTO and effect reconciliation.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No real release candidate, performance target, clinical system or drone flight was reviewed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed candidate freezing, contract/state, memory/lifetime, progress/resources, algorithms/numerics, evidence composition, portability, performance/scale, recovery/observability/operations, security/privacy, human review and decision protocol.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed claim-evidence matrix fields, digest freshness, support cells, strict execution tests, unsafe/FFI inventory, negative probes, systematic/weak-memory/sanitizer triangulation, experiment equivalence, fault injection, waivers, rollout/rollback and PR/release handoff evidence.

pedagogical_review.notes: The capstone synthesizes the full program into a strict decision protocol, demonstrates non-score gate logic, counters eighteen misconceptions, provides ten examples through radiotherapy, and includes five complete exercises ending in autonomous-drone assurance transfer.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external standards body, language/runtime/compiler, OS/MPI/OpenMP/CUDA/SYCL vendor, formal-verification, performance/HPC, reliability/operations, security/privacy, medical/radiotherapy, aviation/drone, quality/regulatory/certification, ethics, accessibility/human-factors or independent validation review is claimed. The chapter and example prove neither any real program's correctness, memory safety, progress, portability, performance, recoverability, security, certification, treatment authorization nor flight/deployment safety.
